task.title: To Configure the OnCall Schedule
task.shortdesc: This topic explains configuring the On-Call Schedule by using the Alarm Class and On Call Recepient in the Wiresheet.

taskbody.context: The On Call Service does not automatically handle all alarms. You must determine and specify which alarms should be sent to your On-Call Lists and configure them to be routed to the OnCall System. The alarms raised from the Alarm Class are handled by the On-call Lists. Based on the scheduling, the active user receives a notification when an alarm is raised. You can also verify the configured schedule, for a particular user, for a queried time period.

step.cmd: Open the OnCall palette, drag an OnCallRecipient to the Alarm Service folder.
Switch to the Wire Sheet view of the Alarm Service, use the link from the Alarm Class to the On Call Recipient. Refer for more details on AlarmClasses.
Expand AlarmServiceOn Call recipient and double-click On Call List Schedule.
step.stepresult: The Scheduler view opens. This schedule determines which OnCallLists is set for a specific time. Use this scheduler to assign the OnCallLists created in to times of day, or events. This schedule determines which OnCallList is active at any time. The active OnCallList is the OnCallList that will receive an alarm when it is raised.

step.cmd: Configure the schedule for the respectiveOnCallList and click Save.

info.note: Configure the scheduler view to eliminate any empty time slots. If a time slot remains unassigned, the system will not route alarms triggered during that interval to any OnCallList.

step.cmd: To verify the schedule for the particular user, you will perform the following steps.

substep.cmd: Double-click on the user from the set OnCall contact.
The On Call User Report View opens.

step.stepresult: It shows the schedule for which user is on call. It shows the OnCall User Report view . For any queried time period, it will show you the schedule for which that user is OnCall.
